name: Web Plura Restaurant Hub – QR Ordering, Kitchen Display & Cashier POS
author: Web Plura

sections.description:
Small restaurants should be able to manage menus, table QR ordering, kitchen tickets, cashier flow, staff access, and daily reports from the WordPress site they already run.

Web Plura Restaurant Hub is a restaurant menu, QR ordering, kitchen display, and POS plugin for WordPress. It is built for small restaurants, cafes, food courts, and local dining teams that want dine-in table ordering without requiring an external account.

Use it to manage menu categories, menu items, tables, QR tokens, manual orders, kitchen tickets, cashier/POS payment recording, browser receipt printing, and daily reports from WordPress. The free package focuses on local restaurant operations for teams that need simple QR table ordering and manual payment workflows.

Restaurant problems it helps with

Restaurant Hub is built for local WordPress workflows such as:

  • Restaurant menu categories, menu items, modifiers, and table setup.
  • Dine-in QR table ordering with secure table tokens.
  • Manual order creation for staff-managed service.
  • Basic kitchen display for order preparation.
  • Cashier/POS payment recording, browser ticket and receipt printing, daily report, and CSV export.
  • Staff roles, customer menu links, kitchen screens, cashier screens, and table/order screens from WordPress-managed data.

Product page: https://wplura.com/products/web-plura-restaurant-hub
Terms: https://wplura.com/terms
Privacy: https://wplura.com/privacy

Free Restaurant Features

  • Menu categories and menu items
  • Table management and secure QR tokens
  • Manual order creation
  • Dine-in QR table ordering
  • Basic kitchen display
  • Cashier/POS payment recording
  • Browser print for tickets and receipts
  • Today report and CSV export
  • Responsive customer menu shell with plus/minus quantity controls
  • Plugin-specific staff roles and capabilities

Good Fit For

  • Small restaurants, cafes, food courts, and local dining teams using WordPress.
  • Dine-in table QR ordering with manual order and cashier workflows.
  • Restaurant staff who need basic kitchen display, ticket printing, receipt printing, and daily CSV exports.
  • Sites that need restaurant ordering without WooCommerce or an external account for the free local workflow.

External Services

This free package does not require an external service connection for its local restaurant features.

Optional Pro Services

Web Plura Restaurant Hub Pro is an optional paid Web Plura product/service for restaurants and agencies that need hosted services, team workflows, reporting history, or larger operational coverage outside this local package. The free package remains usable without a Web Plura account.

Web Plura Restaurant Hub Pro features may change over time. Check the official Web Plura product page for the latest feature list: https://wplura.com/products/web-plura-restaurant-hub-pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the web-plura-restaurant-hub folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Web Plura Restaurant Hub from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Restaurant Hub > Setup Wizard.
  4. Configure menu items, tables, kitchen, cashier, and modes.
sections.faq:
Is WooCommerce required?

No. Web Plura Restaurant Hub uses its own operational tables for restaurant ordering.

Does it support dine-in QR table ordering?

Yes. The free package includes table management, secure QR tokens, customer menu links, and dine-in QR table ordering for local restaurant workflows.

Is an external account required?

No. The free package runs local restaurant features inside WordPress.

Does the free plugin process online card payments?

No. The free package supports cashier/POS payment recording for local restaurant operations. It does not provide external payment checkout or hosted payment processing.

Does the customer UI use quantity number inputs?

No. Customer quantities use minus and plus buttons.

Is this a WordPress restaurant menu and QR ordering plugin?

Yes. The free package includes menu items, categories, tables, secure QR tokens, dine-in QR ordering, kitchen display, cashier/POS payment recording, printing, and reports.

Does the free plugin require WooCommerce checkout?

No. Restaurant Hub uses its own local operational tables and manual payment recording instead of WooCommerce checkout.

Do I need special POS or kitchen printer hardware?

No special hardware is required by the free plugin. Tickets and receipts use browser printing, so the actual printer setup depends on the device and browser used by the restaurant.
sections.changelog:
0.1.45

  • Refreshed the WordPress.org readme for clearer restaurant QR ordering, menu, kitchen display, table, cashier, and local POS search intent.

0.1.44

  • Tightened Restaurant Hub REST responses and permissions so kitchen, waiter, and cashier staff receive only the operational records needed for their role.

0.1.43

  • Restored an informational Restaurant Hub Pro submenu that compares local Restaurant Hub workflows with optional external services without gating bundled features.

0.1.42

  • Removed package access gates and extension suggestion surfaces so bundled restaurant features are controlled only by local settings, roles, and configuration.

0.1.41

  • Sanitized admin and frontend request arrays before internal handling of settings, filters, notices, and local restaurant create actions.

0.1.40

  • Tightened the public menu REST permission callback so the endpoint is only available for active customer menu flows or authorized staff.

0.1.39

  • Hardened public REST permission callbacks for health, customer order status, online payment intent, order creation, and QR table actions.

0.1.38

  • Kept WordPress.org package printing browser-only and fully local.
  • Tightened admin input handling before sanitization.

0.1.37

  • Reworked WordPress.org review preflight handling for public REST callbacks and local feature surfaces.
  • Kept the free package focused on functional local restaurant workflows without inactive controls.

0.1.36

  • Repairs Restaurant Hub roles and administrator capabilities during runtime upgrades so canonical Free admin pages remain reachable after file-only deploys or role drift.
  • Re-arms Restaurant Hub rewrite rule flushing during runtime upgrades so staff and customer app routes recover after file-only deploys without plugin reactivation.
  • Generates plain-permalink-safe staff app, customer order, QR, redirect, and manifest URLs so hosted sandboxes and stores without pretty permalinks keep local workflows reachable.

0.1.35

  • Added a Free-owned core local feature key contract so add-on labels and fallback behavior can reuse the base plugin source of truth.

0.1.34

  • Added a Free-owned orders extension surface so Pro online ordering and cloud operations can render through a reversible override while local order handling remains the fallback.

0.1.33

  • Added the Free-owned dashboard extension surface for reversible Restaurant Hub Pro replacements.

0.1.31

  • Tightened uninstall guard handling for WordPress.org release checks.

0.1.30

  • Refocused the free package on local restaurant operations and removed cloud workflow messaging.
  • Aligned WordPress.org package metadata for the local Restaurant Hub package.

0.1.0

  • Initial MVP scaffold with plugin bootstrap, custom tables, admin pages, REST routes, QR customer route, basic kitchen/cashier flow, browser printing, reports, and responsive assets.
